# Vasool — Full Overview

> Vasool is a voice-entry loan collection and lending platform for money lenders, finance companies and NBFCs in India. Built by Thukal. The website is bilingual (English and Tamil, /ta pages). Field staff use an Android/iOS app; the office uses a web dashboard; borrowers get a self-service portal. Works fully offline and syncs when back online.

## What Vasool does

Vasool digitises the daily/weekly/monthly "vasool" (collection) round that lenders traditionally run on paper. A field agent records a payment by speaking — for example "Arun 500 cash" — and it is logged against the right customer automatically, in six languages (English, Tamil, Telugu, Hindi, Malayalam, Kannada). Voice entry is not India-only: it works in every country Vasool supports, in the languages officers speak on those routes — Swahili in Kenya, Filipino in the Philippines, Bahasa Indonesia, Spanish in Colombia, Afrikaans and isiZulu in South Africa, Sinhala in Sri Lanka, Hausa and Yoruba in Nigeria. The same platform scales from a single-route money lender to a multi-branch NBFC through per-tenant feature flags; each company runs in its own isolated database on infrastructure it controls.

## Loan and finance products

- Daily loans — small loans repaid through daily field collections
- Weekly loans — weekly cycles, with optional custom per-week stepped amounts
- Monthly and semi-monthly loans — for salaried and business borrowers
- EMI loans — equated instalments, 15-day/30-day variants, foreclosure and tenure controls
- Interest-only loans — "kandhu vatti" / "byaj": simple, compound or daily interest, optional weekly cadence
- Gold loans — gold-backed lending with live per-gram rate, valuation and redemption
- Product-based loans — loans tied to physical goods (daily/weekly/monthly/semi-monthly)
- Chit funds (Agent Chit) — groups, members, cycles, foreman commission, late fees, WhatsApp reminders
- Savings schemes (Savings Chit) — festival/deposit schemes with cash or goods maturity payouts
- Gold business (gold sales) — liquidate pledged gold from a defaulted loan or sell standalone: recover the outstanding, take a flat or percentage owner deduction, pay the surplus back to the customer, with per-item photos, a sales dashboard and a gold sale report

## Operations and modules

- Voice AI ("Vasool AI") — one recording becomes an app action: create loans, log collections, add expenses, add customers, call a customer by name, query reports. Speech is converted to a structured record, not stored as audio, and the matched borrower and amount are confirmed before saving
- AI loan eligibility — aggregates a borrower's history into a risk score with approve/review/reject and a suggested limit
- WhatsApp reminders — server-side sends via the lender's own provider account (Meta, Interakt, Gupshup, WATI, AiSensy)
- Collection & payments — cash and UPI, automatic PDF receipts, payment history, admin cash settlement
- Route management — plan daily/weekly routes, assign to staff, GPS navigation, completion tracking. Every collection and expense is tagged to its route, which is what makes the per-route day book and per-officer end-of-day cash settlement possible
- Staff tools — live GPS tracking, location history, role-based access control, staff attendance
- Maker-checker approvals — staff creates/edits/deletes can be held for owner or manager approval before they take effect; enabled per role and per resource, covering customers, loans, chit and savings schemes, gold sales, expenses, staff, roles and routes. Individual collection entries CANNOT be gated yet (roadmap) — a spoken collection posts once the officer confirms the match. Approvals are never given by voice: capture is spoken, authorisation is a deliberate action in the approvals inbox. Together these are positioned as the voice approval workflow, available in every supported country
- Row-level data scoping — roles default to View Own; View All is granted per resource, so a manager can see every customer but only their own loans
- Financials — income & expense ledger (expenses can be dictated by voice and carry a receipt photo), day book per route, cash advances, profit & loss reports
- Cash & accounts — register UPI, company and personal accounts, tag every transaction to the account it hit, and pull a date-ranged cash-flow-by-account report plus a cash book, both as PDF
- Office web dashboard — full browser app for the office: every loan product, reports with PDF/CSV export, approvals inbox, roles and permissions, staff attendance, and live staff/customer maps
- Funding & investors — partner capital (profit-share) and financier borrowings (the liability side)
- Customer management — profiles, KYC document vault (Aadhaar, PAN, voter ID, ration card, gas bill), referee/guarantor linking, live customer location
- Customer self-service portal — borrowers see balances, dues and receipts
- Reporting — dashboards, officer performance (collection efficiency, attendance, route stats, expense breakdown), collection summaries, overdue/DPD tracking, cash flow by account, cash book, gold sale report, P&L. PDF and CSV export on each, and reports can be queried by voice. NOT included: credit-bureau reporting, NPA classification to regulator norms, automated mobile-money import — all roadmap

## Security and data ownership

- Each tenant runs in a separate database and storage; no cross-tenant access
- Data lives on infrastructure the client provides or designates — Vasool does not centrally store it
- TLS/SSL in transit, JWT authentication, biometric login, granular role-based access control, row-level data scoping and maker-checker approvals
- Full audit trail with entity-level change history on every record
- Bot/attack protection and rate limiting
- On the roadmap: formal certifications (SOC 2, ISO 27001) and RBI-aligned compliance modules (CKYC, credit-bureau reporting). Vasool supports a lender's compliance; it does not replace their obligations.

## Deployment

- Multi-tenant: one Docker container + PostgreSQL database per company, behind a shared reverse proxy
- Self-hosting and white-labelling available — run under your own brand on your own servers
- Free plan to get started; standard plan from ₹699/month, custom pricing for multiple loan products
